name: Exceptionless
summary: Exceptionless is an open-source error and event tracker that can be hosted free on your own server. The hosted service runs from a free plan with 3,000 events a month to $15 for 15,000 events, $99 for 250,000 and $499 for 3 million, with prices listed monthly only.

facts.text: Exceptionless groups matching events into stacks automatically, and stacks can also be built by hand.
A stack marked fixed is flagged as regressed when a newer matching event arrives, or one that reports a higher version than the recorded fix.
On the free plan, error notifications arrive only as daily summaries, and searching, webhooks, Slack and Zapier need a paid plan.
Passing the event limit triggers a notice, and continued overages can require an upgrade or lead to account closure.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 3,000 events a month, 1 project, 1 user, 3-day retention

plans.name: Small
plans.notes: 15,000 events a month, 5 projects, 10 users, 30-day retention

plans.name: Medium
plans.notes: 75,000 events a month, 15 projects, 25 users, 90-day retention

plans.name: Large
plans.notes: 250,000 events a month, unlimited projects and users, 180-day retention

hiddenCosts: Self-hosting is free but you run the servers, upgrades and storage yourself.
The pricing page does not state where hosted data is stored.
